data.name: Watershed
data.description: Watershed is an enterprise sustainability software platform that helps companies measure, report, and reduce emissions, and operates a curated marketplace of vetted carbon removal projects (DAC, bio-oil, biochar, ERW, reforestation, and more) that its enterprise customers can purchase from. Watershed does not physically remove CO2; it acts as an accounting platform and marketplace intermediary in the CDR ecosystem. Customers include Walmart, Airbnb, Stripe, Klarna, and Block.
